entries.name: Simulation Isolation
entries.body: Shadow Mode and Simulation Mode outputs must never be served as production responses. Strict isolation between simulation and production.

entries.name: Rate Limiting
entries.body: No single user or application may consume more than its allocated routing capacity. Overflow triggers queuing, not rejection.

entries.name: Error Transparency
entries.body: Routing errors must be reported to the user with a human-readable explanation and the TransparencyPacket reference.

entries.name: Backward Compatibility
entries.body: New routing modules must support the previous version's API contract for at least one major version cycle.

entries.name: Council Seat Rotation
entries.body: Provisional seats are reviewed every 6 months. Active seats are reviewed annually. No seat is permanent except S144 (Ghost Seat).
